# Kiwi Van Market

> Campervan marketplace in New Zealand / Annonces de vans en Nouvelle-Zélande.

Canonical: https://kiwivanmarket.com/
Content reviewed: 2026-10-12

Owner listings are free, with no sales commission. Vehicle details are seller-provided; buyers should verify documents and inspect vehicles. Asking-price data describes this platform's advertised inventory, not completed sales or the whole NZ market.

Les annonces de particuliers sont gratuites et sans commission sur la vente. Les informations sont déclarées par les vendeurs : vérifiez les documents et inspectez le véhicule. Les données de prix portent sur les prix demandés sur cette plateforme, pas sur les ventes conclues ou l'ensemble du marché.

## English

Kiwi Van Market connects campervan buyers and sellers in New Zealand. Compare advertised prices, locations, equipment and seller-provided vehicle details; contact owners directly and inspect the vehicle before agreeing a purchase.

- [Buy and sell a campervan in New Zealand](https://kiwivanmarket.com/)
- [sell](https://kiwivanmarket.com/sell)
- [guides](https://kiwivanmarket.com/guides)
- [faq](https://kiwivanmarket.com/faq)

### Guides
- [How to Buy a Campervan in New Zealand: Checks, Costs & Paperwork](https://kiwivanmarket.com/guide/buying-campervan-nz): Buy a campervan in NZ with a practical checklist for prices, inspection, WoF, rego, RUC and green-warrant certification. Official sources and handover steps.
- [Used Campervan Inspection Checklist NZ: How to Check a Van Before Buying](https://kiwivanmarket.com/guide/campervan-buyer-checklist): A chronological pre-purchase routine for campervans in New Zealand — the homework the night before, the first minutes on site, the walk-around, the test drive, and the handover. Free printable version.
- [WOF, REGO, RUC & Insurance in New Zealand: Van Rules Explained Simply](https://kiwivanmarket.com/guide/wof-rego-ruc-insurance-nz): The four vehicle rules every campervan traveller must understand in NZ — what they cost, when they're due, and the fines if you get them wrong. In plain English.
- [Freedom Camping in New Zealand - Rules & Best Spots 2025](https://kiwivanmarket.com/guide/freedom-camping-nz): Complete guide to freedom camping in New Zealand. Where you can camp for free, self-contained requirements, fines to avoid, and the best freedom camping spots.
- [How to Sell Your Campervan in New Zealand - Quick Sale Guide](https://kiwivanmarket.com/guide/selling-campervan-nz): Sell your campervan fast in New Zealand. Tips for pricing, photos, descriptions, and reaching backpacker buyers. Free listings on Kiwi Van Market.
- [Expert Campervan Inspection - The Ultimate NZ Checklist](https://kiwivanmarket.com/guide/how-to-inspect-campervan-nz): Don't buy a lemon! Our expert guide covers everything from engine health and structural rust to living system checks. Inspect like a pro before you buy.
- [Survival Guide: Winter Camping in New Zealand 2025](https://kiwivanmarket.com/guide/winter-camping-nz): Can you camp in NZ during winter? Yes! Discover the best heated vans, snow-safe roads, and essential gear to stay warm while exploring the Southern Alps.
- [The Ultimate 14-Day South Island Road Trip Itinerary](https://kiwivanmarket.com/guide/south-island-road-trip): The most iconic road trip in the world. From Christchurch to Milford Sound, discover the best hidden campsites and photo spots for your van adventure.
- [6 Essential Apps for Every NZ Vanlife Traveller (2025)](https://kiwivanmarket.com/guide/best-vanlife-apps-nz): Don't leave without these! From finding secret campsites to saving money on fuel, these apps will save you time and hundreds of dollars.
- [Top 10 Best Campervans to Buy in New Zealand (2025 Ranking)](https://kiwivanmarket.com/guide/top-10-best-vans-nz): The definitive ranking of the 10 best campervans for backpackers in New Zealand. Prices, reliability, resale value and expert tips for each model.

En français simple.

- [L'Itinéraire Ultime du Road Trip de 14 Jours dans l'Île du Sud](https://kiwivanmarket.com/guide/south-island-road-trip?lang=fr): Le voyage le plus iconique au monde. De Christchurch à Milford Sound, découvrez les meilleurs spots.
